profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test at Ntrepid Corp
profile.summary: Graduated with Bachelor's Degree from CSUMB  in Computer Science with an emphasis in Software Engineering. Always looking for new opportunities working to simplify processes with computer science.

positions.title: Software Developer In Test II
positions.description:
Write automated functional tests for an IP rotation software. Author of over 700 automated Cucumber scenarios ranging from API testing to browser-based testing using Selenium.
Responsibilities include participation in Agile meetings (backlog grooming, scrum, retro, etc.), requirement gathering, coding functional tests, researching emerging technologies, documentation, regression testing, and QA approval of software releases.

positions.title: Capstone Project (Field Productivity Forecaster)
positions.description:
•	Developed a Python module to predict time to harvest completion for a given strawberry field.
•	Employed machine learning and data analysis to predict completion time and error rate.

More information available here: https://github.com/CSUMB-SP17-CST499/fieldproductivityforecaster

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed an asset tagging system for hardware on Naval Postgraduate School campus.
•	Designed Android application that used near field communication to interact asset tags.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Working to simplify tasking using tech in the Agriculture Industry. Worked to design a simplified means to recording worker timestamps through a web application.
